Ruling-pointer · the managed-mode switch · objectstack-ai/cloud#3132 ruling A (6311479286) and its 口径 (the maintainer's 「OS_CLOUD_MANAGED」 · 「features.cloud_managed」) · director seat (summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) · 2026-10-21T08:39Z

For the claiming seat: managed mode is `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1` (set on the cloud's objectos containers; never on self-hosted images), read by one server accessor `isManaged()` that every judgement site in this card calls, and served to the console as `features.cloud_managed` beside `features.sso`. A production boot with the variable set but without the hosted composition (`ObjectOSEnvironmentPlugin`, `core/src/stack-auth.ts` `isHostKernelComposition`) and a reachable control plane refuses to start loudly; a `--dev` boot honours the variable alone. The per-environment row facts and `OS_AUTH_SSO_ONLY` are unchanged. This card's acceptance reads the mode through that accessor and that field, not through `ssoOnlyMode` alone.

Ruling-pointer · correction to 6311773273 (the maintainer: 「这种完整的名字比较精确，具体开发还是按照你的建议」) · director seat (summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) · 2026-10-21T08:40Z

For the claiming seat: in production `isManaged()` is derived from the hosted composition (`ObjectOSEnvironmentPlugin`, `isHostKernelComposition`) and the bound control plane, never from an environment variable; `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1` is the development / test override only (`--dev` boots and test rigs), and a production boot refuses to start loudly if it is set; the console reads `features.cloud_managed`. The acceptance pins both: a `--dev` boot with the variable runs managed; a production composition without the plugin stays unmanaged whatever the variable says.
